description: HyRiver is a collection of Python libraries for retrieving and preparing hydroclimate data from web services. The project repository describes tools for subsetting hydrographic networks, terrain and meteorological products, with results returned as geospatial tables or labelled arrays. Its current documentation concentrates on United States data, including NHDPlus river networks. A modeller can use the stack to assemble catchment geometry and forcing for flood, reservoir or water-supply simulations. The public repository links the individual packages and installation instructions; its own licence is MIT, while component and upstream data terms should be checked for the selected workflow. A limitation is dependence on remote service limits, data availability and local memory when assembling large requests. Spatial and temporal resolution come from the chosen providers. No directly related catalogue record was established. This review read the stack documentation and licence without downloading input datasets or running its retrieval functions. The code is available free of charge under its stated licence.
